name: Quantum D C Public Company Limited
summary: Quantum D C Public Company Limited is a Bangkok-based Thai enterprise, established in 2004, primarily focused on the food and beverage sector within Thailand. Its restaurant operations feature the HOTPOT BUFFET brand, known for its Suki Shabu offerings, and Daidomon Korea Grill, which provides a Korean-style grilled buffet experience. Beyond its dining ventures, the company also holds interests in property, including the rental of office buildings, and is active in the hotel industry. The firm was formerly recognized as JCK Hospitality Public Company Limited, changing its official designation to Quantum D C Public Company Limited in November 2025.
